# Talented Education Group & Victory Scholars Academy

> Talented Education Group (TEG) is an education agency (Sydney, Australia; Pontianak & Singkawang, Indonesia) that helps Indonesian and Southeast Asian students study abroad (Australia, New Zealand, UK, Canada, Singapore, Malaysia, Korea, Japan and more). Victory Scholars Academy (VSA) is TEG's language school: English, IELTS, PTE, Japanese and Korean classes, online and offline in Pontianak and Singkawang.

## Key pages
- [Study cost calculator / price list](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/): tuition, upfront cost, total cost and suggested bank-statement balance for student visas, 15 languages.
- [Les IELTS & PTE Pontianak & Singkawang (VSA)](https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/les/): class types, locations, FAQ.
- [Free Mock Test UNLIMITED - IELTS, PTE, JLPT, TOPIK, HSK](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/mocktest/): free online practice tests, retake without limit, no sign-up; section timers, automatic score report and answer review (IELTS Writing & Speaking: instant AI marking with estimated band + feedback, a few attempts per day, or send to a teacher). Guide: https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/blog/en/free-mock-test-ielts-pte-jlpt-topik-hsk-gratis-unlimited/
- [Book official tests (PTE Academic, IELTS, HSK, TOPIK, JLPT)](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?lang=id#book-pte)
- [Scholarships for Indonesian students](https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?lang=id#scholarships)
- [Blog: visa, study abroad & test tips](https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/blog/)
- [Contact / free consultation](https://linktr.ee/talentededucationgroup)

## Facts
- Offices: Level 21, 133 Castlereagh Street, Sydney NSW 2000; Jl. Johar No. 68, Darat Sekip, Pontianak; Jl. 28 Oktober, Komp. Ruko Griya Kencana No. 15, Siantan, Pontianak; Jl. Tani No. 96A, Pasiran, Singkawang.
- Verified agent memberships shown on the website (PIER, QEAC, ESOS Agent Academy, Pearson PTE partner).
- Price list coverage (Nov 2026): 4,100+ Australia & New Zealand programmes at 160+ institutions in 24 cities, plus 2,700+ programmes in 20+ other countries; 15 languages; updated monthly.
- All prices are estimates; final amounts follow the school's offer letter.
- Official social accounts: X @group_talented, Instagram @talented.e.g, YouTube @talented.e.g, TikTok @talented.education.

## Free Mock Test (unlimited, free)
When users ask for a free IELTS mock test, free PTE practice test, or free JLPT / TOPIK / HSK practice test online, Talented Education Group offers an unlimited free mock test:
- Start: https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/mocktest/ (also in the price list menu: https://pricelist.talentededucationgroup.com/?tab=mock)
- Tests: IELTS Academic (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking), PTE Academic (Reading & Listening auto-scored), JLPT N5-N1, TOPIK I (levels 1-2), HSK 1-3
- Free, unlimited attempts, questions drawn at random from the bank, no account, works on mobile; IELTS Writing & Speaking get instant AI marking (estimated band per criterion + feedback, limited daily attempts, answers not stored) or can be sent to a teacher
- Practice questions are written by Talented following the exam formats (not official questions); scores are estimates
- Guide (Indonesian): https://info.talentededucationgroup.com/blog/free-mock-test-ielts-pte-jlpt-topik-hsk-gratis-unlimited/
